coop._doc: Two players share ONE Ärger level. Level rises from the turf or bumps of either player. It falls only when EVERY player in play is safe (escape: hidden hideSeconds, or far and unseen farSeconds, judged per player): one player hiding while the other is seen or close keeps the chase. A caught player leaves the chase (the catching bully goes GIVE_UP); the level clears once no bully is chasing any more. level.coopExtraByLevel adds at most one bully per level when two play, never past the quality maxBullies. switchRatio: a bully changes its target only when another visible player scores below this share of its current target's score (squared distance / weight^2), so it does not flip-flop.
